test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

We hope that we shall win the match against Australia.

options.text: It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us.
It is expected that the match against Australia should be won by us.
It is hoped that the match against Australia was won by us.
It is sure that the match against Australia was won by us.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• The given sentence has two clauses.
 
• When a principle clause is followed by a noun clause as an object, the passive voice is made as follows:
 
 
• Principle clause + conjunction + noun clause. (Active Voice)
 
• It + is/am/are + verb + by + object + conjunction + noun clause. (Passive Voice) 
 
 
 
• **"It" **is often used as a placeholder subject in passive voice constructions when the original subject isn't explicitly stated or when the focus is on the action rather than the doer of the action.
 
• In the provided sentence, *"It is hoped by us that the match against Australia shall be won," *"**It**" serves as a placeholder subject in the passive construction, allowing the sentence to emphasize the action of hoping for a victory in the match without focusing on who is doing the hoping.
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *We hope that Hansa will clear the exam.*
 
• *It is hoped that Hansa will clear the exam.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *It is hoped that the match against Australia shall be won by us.*
